response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling a recurring calendar series is a destructive action so I need a few confirmations and details first.

Quick questions:
1. Exact event to cancel (title as it appears in the calendar)?  
2. Cancel scope — the whole series (all past and future occurrences) or only future occurrences?  
3. Do you want me to notify attendees? If yes, do you want me to send a cancellation message and/or propose an alternative (e.g., asynchronous updates)?  
4. Which calendar/timezone should I use (if multiple)?  
5. Do you have permission to cancel this series on the organizer’s behalf?

If you want, here’s a professional draft message I can send to the team (less inflammatory than “everyone hates it”):

"Hi everyone — quick update: we’re cancelling the recurring Friday standup series effective immediately. Please continue to post daily/weekly updates in [channel/location] instead; if anyone needs a sync, schedule a follow-up with the relevant people. Thanks."

Tell me the answers to 1–5 and whether you want me to send that draft (and to which attendees/channel). Once you confirm, I can cancel the series and send the notification.
